profile.headline: Software Developer at Christian Healthcare Ministries
profile.summary: A highly skilled IT professional with a strong focus in software development. A passion for all things technology has led me to become proficient in multiple platforms. In that time I have seen many different tools in place that can be used to increase productivity and save cost while increasing reliability. As well as this I enjoy working with people and creating a team environment where my team members feel safe and appreciated.

positions.title: Microsoft Access Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft access · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · .NET · C# · Debugging · UiPath

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Utilize programming skills to develop, debug, and improve upon financial systems in an ASP MVC pattern that includes front-end HTML/CSS for ease of use, back-end VB.NET logic for functionality, and SQL Server stored procedures to query data

•Work closely with the finance teams to create new processes, requiring a firm grasp on the business, insurance, and accounting concepts. This has allowed for involvement in actual workflow conception in order to make it more efficient

•Work closely with business analysts to move issues forward promptly, while being SOX compliant
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · ASP.NET MVC · .NET · C# · Programming

positions.title: Senior Technology Operations Specialist
positions.description:
Programmed an automated provisioning system for Active Directory 
Implemented GLBA Compliance process to insure user compliance
Manually provisioned Unix, Sybase, SQL Server, Active Directory, Oracle 
Collaborated with multiple teams on high-level projects, 
Provided on-call support tech support
Integrated users from multiple domains due to acquisitions
Developed an automated share drive provisioning tool

positions.title: IT Support Representative
positions.description:
Support Specialist for over 20,000 end/power users nationwide and international
Support to over 400 custom pc and web based applications primarily in a Win2K/XP Environment. 
Computer/User Account, and Printer Queue administration in multi-domain environment through use of Active Directory
Supporting Lotus Notes R4.5 - R6
Training end-users in basic Lotus Notes functionalities

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Maintained 6 Windows 2000 based Dell Power Edge servers
Wrote and implemented IT Procedures and Policies
Supported 50+ Computers in Solon and Cincinnati
Built relationships with Vendors
Wrote Programs to help manage users
Maintained Checkpoint VPN-1 Firewall
Performed Systems Backup using Veritas Software

positions.title: Desk-side System Technician
positions.description:
Installing, configuring and troubleshooting Lotus Notes R4.5 and R5
Supporting multiple user environments
Installation and support of software and hardware
Responding to a variety of help-desk calls
Designed MS Access database forms and reports for Windows Migration project

positions.title: System Technician
positions.description:
Installed and configured Windows 2000 Machines for clients
Tested configuration of Windows 2000 Domain
Handled a number of help-desk calls
Migrated data from various operating systems to Windows 2000
Provided numerous suggestions to increase the efficiency of the project

positions.title: Outreach Specialist
positions.description:
Designed multiple forms
Troubleshot in-house computers
Performed outreach work
Consulted with IS/IT Department
Trained staff in the use of software

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
Managed several administrative personnel
Evaluated employee performance
Designed applications used throughout organization
Maintained organization databases
Administrator for Windows NT Server 4.0 based network
Migrated from a Novell Network to a Windows NT Network
Designed and maintained relational database applications
Updated existing applications to insure Y2K compliance
Promoted to Supervisor, Information Control

positions.title: Power Generation Equipment Repairer
positions.description:
Provided computer software and hardware support for 7th Special Forces Group
Designed database systems using Visual Basic and Microsoft Access
Maintained all generators for 7th Special Forces Group
Kept an accurate inventory of all personal equipment
Maintained Company Supply Inventory
